title: How paqad reaches a teammate or cloud session with nothing installed once the startup file (.paqad/hook.mjs) leaves the project
context: A teammate or cloud session opens the project with nothing of paqad installed. Once the startup file leaves the project (#918), how should paqad reach them? This decides whether new teammates still get the team's checks with no steps, and how the first-session guide (docs/site-map/journeys/team-bootstrap-first-session.journey.yaml) is rewritten. The startup file cannot be removed until this is answered. Technical: plugin = committed enabledPlugins + extraKnownMarketplaces in .claude/settings.json, plugin carries every hook (D4, honouring ref and cloud plugin install, is verified at build); pinned command = npx -y paqad-ai@<version> hook <script>; cloud setup = npm i -g paqad-ai@<version> && paqad-ai install && paqad-ai join --no-rag --non-interactive (proven on #917).
